A typed &Global binding is byte-identical: the &Global -> &Global coercion inserts a reborrow that MIR ReferencePropagation rewrites to re-derive (*box).account at the call, so the binding is dead
A GEP left in bb58 is sunk by InstCombine because bb64's unique predecessor is bb58; a GEP in bb57 is not
